alert_news.title: IBM to install India's first quantum computer in Amaravati in early 2027
bullets: India’s first quantum computer will be installed at the Andhra Pradesh Quantum Valley tech park in Amaravati by IBM.
It will be the largest quantum computer in India, operational early 2027, aimed at post‑quantum cryptography and practical applications.

alert_news.title: India's First Indigenous Satellite Launch Vehicle (SLV-3)
bullets: India’s first indigenous satellite launch vehicle, SLV-3, developed by ISRO, successfully launched the Rohini satellite into Earth orbit on 20 July 1980.
SLV-3 was a four‑stage solid‑fuel rocket with a payload capacity of 100 kg, marking India’s entry into independent space launch capability.
The project, led by Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam, laid the foundation for subsequent Indian launch vehicles such as PSLV and GSLV.

alert_news.title: Andhra Pradesh's Visakhapatnam ITI cluster becomes India's first to win PM-SETU approval
bullets: India’s first ITI cluster to receive PM‑SETU approval, located in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, sanctioned by the PM‑SETU National Steering Committee
Rs 200 crore investment to upgrade four government ITIs, with AM/NS India holding 51% stake and the state and central governments 24.5% each

alert_news.title: Vizag ITI cluster becomes first in India to secure PM-SETU approval
bullets: First ITI cluster in India to receive approval under the Centre’s PM‑SETU scheme, located in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.
Four government ITIs upgraded with a ₹200 crore investment from AM/NS India, with a Special Purpose Vehicle; PM‑SETU National Steering Committee cleared the cluster’s Strategic Investment Plan.
Initiative modernises training infrastructure, introduces workplace‑relevant courses, and strengthens employability of Andhra Pradesh youth.
